Metrics are source-specific. Do not average survey usage, website-detection data, production-adoption surveys, repository counts or vendor figures into a synthetic universal popularity score. Country and gender cross-tabs are left blank unless directly supported.

Usage_Signals: Stack Overflow 2025 out-of-box AI agent/coding assistant usage
Current_Snapshots: Codex exists across CLI, IDE extension, desktop app and cloud; OpenAI reported more than 5M weekly users by June 2026.
IDE quickstart documents chat, completion and agent mode; GitHub also exposes a cloud coding agent.
Anthropic's terminal agent supports Windows via WSL or Git Bash and can edit files/run commands.
Cursor Agent supports codebase search, multi-file edits and terminal execution.
Open-source assistant for VS Code and JetBrains with agent/chat/edit/autocomplete and CLI.
AWS states IDE plugin support ends 30 Apr 2027 and directs users toward Kiro for similar capabilities.
Google docs state individual tiers moved to Antigravity/Antigravity CLI from 18 Jun 2026.
Methodology: Issue
CODARIS treatment
Reason
Catalogue boundary

Separates end-user coding assistants, agent surfaces, specific capabilities, evaluation benchmarks, agent frameworks/model-serving support and context/tool protocols. Product status is time-sensitive; major 2026 products are grounded in current official docs.
A declared taxonomy boundary is more defensible than claiming a finite list of every tool ever created.
Popularity/adoption
Only attach a metric when the source directly measures that named item and population.
Different surveys and telemetry measure different things.
Cross-category overlap
Allow overlap where a tool has multiple genuine roles; label its role in each category.
For example GitHub is a code host while GitHub Actions is CI/CD.
Country data
Do not derive per-tool country usage from overall survey geography.
Overall respondent geography is not a tool-by-country cross-tab.
Gender data
Do not fabricate male/female or other demographic shares by tool.
A direct cross-tab with sample sizes and all source categories is needed.
Lifecycle
Legacy/historical items may be retained for educational context, but inclusion is not a recommendation to adopt.
CODARIS is an educational catalogue, not a procurement ranking.
Sources: Among respondents using out-of-the-box AI agents/copilots, ChatGPT 82% and GitHub Copilot 68%.
AI-enabled development environments were included with IDEs; Cursor and Claude Code had meaningful adoption.
Codex available through app, CLI, IDE and cloud; Windows app announced March 2026.
OpenAI - Unrolling the Codex agent loop
Describes Codex CLI as a cross-platform local software agent.
Copilot supports suggestions, chat and agent mode in supported IDEs.
Terminal coding agent with file editing, commands, permissions and integrations.
Agent can explore codebases, edit files and run terminal commands.
Open-source VS Code/JetBrains AI code assistant with Agent, Chat, Edit and Autocomplete.
Autonomous multi-step coding agent integrated with JetBrains IDEs.
IDE/CLI coding assistant; AWS notes IDE plugin support ends 30 Apr 2027 in favor of Kiro.
